# rekordbox test fixtures

Copied from the [rekordcrate](https://github.com/Holzhaus/rekordcrate) project's test data
(`data/complete_export/demo_tracks`, `data/pdb/num_rows/export.pdb`, `data/anlz/sweep`),
licensed MPL-2.0. The expected row counts in `src/rekordbox/pdb.rs` tests come from the same
project's test suite. No audio files are included.
